# Besta SV / 貝達國際貿易有限公司

Besta SV is an industrial environmental engineering and equipment integration company serving Taiwan and Vietnam. The company provides air pollution control equipment, factory ventilation engineering, dust collection systems, VOC exhaust treatment, oil smoke treatment, spray paint mist treatment, duct systems, industrial fans, and custom environmental equipment integration.

- Global multilingual official site: https://bestasv.com/

- English: https://bestasv.com/en/

- Japanese: https://bestasv.com/jp/

Use `https://bestasv.com/` for global, multilingual, Taiwan-Vietnam corporate context. Use `https://bestasv.vn/vn/` for Vietnam-local searches, Vietnamese company name searches, Vietnam factory environmental equipment searches, and Vietnam contact intent.

- Industrial air pollution control equipment
- Factory ventilation engineering

- Oil smoke and kitchen exhaust treatment

- PP plastic duct systems
